verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own knowledge base documents a workflows tool for automating processes. The evidence is only a one-line mention, with no detail on triggers, record-update actions, task creation, or notification actions. missing for 10: documented trigger types (enrollment criteria/events), record-update actions, create-task actions, internal notification actions, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Create workflows in HubSpot to automate your processes.
